display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cause: No auth mechanism configured (KANBAN_AUTH_TOKEN,
KANBAN_AUTH_SECRET, and KANBAN_PROJECT_TOKENS all unset),
or KANBAN_PROJECT_TOKENS is malformed JSON.
Fix: Set a valid token / valid JSON map and restart the server.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cause: Missing or incorrect Bearer token / X-API-Token.
Fix: Check token matches server's KANBAN_AUTH_TOKEN.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cause: Missing role or role not allowed to perform transition.
Fix: Supply valid X-Agent-Role matching permission matrix
(e.g., only a Reviewer can move to VALIDATION, only a Releaser to DONE).

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cause: Illegal state transition (e.g. BACKLOG -> DONE)
or task is already claimed by a different agent.
Fix: Check transition graph and verify card ownership.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cause: Missing required fields (id, title, positive round)
or invalid task ID characters.
Fix: Use alphanumeric/dash ID and include round: 1.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cause: Storage failure (disk full, permission, git commit failure).
Fix: Check server console output; reconcile git index if in git mode.
